headline: X Money is launching in the US starting today
summary: X Money, Elon Musk's "everything app" payment platform, launches today in the US. It offers a digital wallet and peer-to-peer payments, similar to Venmo. Users can get a metal Visa card with their X username and Apple Wallet support.

headline: Razer's analog Huntsman V3 Pro is over 20 percent off
summary: Razer's Huntsman V3 Pro TKL gaming keyboard, featuring adjustable optical switches, is on sale. It offers enhanced customization and faster response times for gamers. Get this compact, wired keyboard now at over 20 percent off.

headline: Xbox's huge outage even blocked games on disc
summary: An extensive Xbox outage blocked users from playing both digital and disc-based games. The issue began Sunday evening, preventing logins and app launches. Xbox status page reported widespread service disruptions.

headline: Nanoleaf's colorful pegboard and shelf kit is half off
summary: Nanoleaf's Blocks Combo XL Smarter Kit is now half price at $99.99. This kit combines smart lighting panels with a low-profile shelf and pegboard. It's a fun way to add customizable light and storage to your wall.

headline: Pick Up an 11-Outlet Clamp-Style Power Strip With LED Night Light Illumination for Just $17.99
summary: Grab an 11-outlet clamp-style power strip with built-in LED night light. This convenient gadget offers ample power connections. Get it now for only $17.99.

headline: Pick up a Big and Tall Gaming Chair for Less Than $140 With Free Shipping on Amazon
summary: A comfortable big and tall gaming chair is available for under $140. Enjoy free shipping when you purchase on Amazon. This deal offers an inviting chair without the high price tag.

headline: Ubisoft Gives Free PC Copies to Xbox Owners of Select Games
summary: Ubisoft is offering free PC versions of certain games. This promotion is exclusively for existing Xbox owners. Expand your gaming library across platforms at no extra cost.

headline: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra Review
summary: The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra is Samsung's new flagship foldable. It boasts improved battery life and camera features. However, its $2099 price tag remains a significant hurdle.

headline: Wildfire now nine miles from French city of Bordeaux, mayor warns
summary: A wildfire is now just nine miles from Bordeaux, France. The city's mayor warns of potential further evacuations. A nearby town mayor describes the situation as "catastrophic."

headline: Devastating European wildfires in maps - and how they're being tackled
summary: Wildfires are ravaging Europe, with a blaze near Bordeaux burning 162 sq miles. Madrid is experiencing its worst fires ever, impacting vast areas. This report details the scale of the devastation and response efforts.

headline: Reform UK reports Zack Polanski to police over guillotine T-shirt post
summary: Reform UK has reported Zack Polanski to the police. The complaint concerns a T-shirt post featuring a guillotine and the name "Nigel." The incident has sparked controversy and a formal police report.

headline: New technical education routes to be offered at 14 in England
summary: England will introduce new technical education routes for 14-year-olds. The government aims to link these subjects, like AI and manufacturing, to local job markets. This initiative seeks to better prepare students for future careers.
